reason: We'd maybe go once or twice a month, so $49-59 a month for unlimited is way more than I'd use. At $12 a visit it's still a stretch on our budget when the library and park are free.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and it's a 15 minute drive from Fruitland each way. Drop-in at $12 plus gas adds up for what is basically a coffee and a play area.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper drop-in or a 5 or 10 visit pack around $8 a visit that doesn't expire, plus proof it's a decent place to get some work done with the toddler playing.
